speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms and if you have noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. Do you have any history of tuberculosis exposure, recent travel, or known HIV status, as these risk factors are important given your symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; a fixed, painless supraclavicular lymph node is a significant finding. To help narrow down the cause, have you noticed any itching (pruritus) all over your body, or have you consumed alcohol recently that made this node painful?

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: The abdominal fullness and tight clothing suggest significant organ enlargement, likely the spleen or liver, which aligns with your other symptoms. I need to visualize the extent of this involvement to proceed, so I will request imaging now. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of B symptoms, a fixed supraclavicular node, and abdominal fullness is highly concerning for lymphoma. I will order a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Lymph_Node_Biopsy
